fixes.new:
The true form of $$アウストラリス$$, the emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$ and ruler of $$サイデリアル$$.
His true identity is one of the Dimensional Generals who stand against the fundamental calamity, and at the same time the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$立ち上がる射手$$'.
Among the four Dimensional Generals in existence, he held a leader-like position. After being defeated in a past battle with the $$御使い$$s, he set his sights on the $$スフィア$$s for further power, defeated the Reactor of the $$立ち上がる射手$$, and took that power. Thereupon he accepted an invitation from the $$御使い$$s, showed an attitude of submission, obtained the position of ruler of $$サイデリアル$$, and kept waiting for a chance to rebel while raising his own power.
Normally, Reactors belonging to $$サイデリアル$$ were bound by a restriction that prevented them from absorbing one another's $$スフィア$$s, but by awakening the power of a Dimensional General, which has the ability to absorb $$スフィア$$s, $$ヴィルダーク$$ made the $$スフィア$$s of $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$ his own.
However, this action had already been anticipated by the $$御使い$$s, and the plan of $$ヴィルダーク$$ was tacitly allowed as a means of drawing out the power of the $$立ち上がる射手$$, which takes defiance as its power.
Though he boasts tremendous combat power that fuses the power of a Dimensional General and the $$スフィア$$s, he was defeated in the battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$ and left the Earth. However, he declared war on the $$御使い$$s who appeared on Earth, and acquired the skill to wield four $$スフィア$$s in order to defeat them.
Inwardly he acknowledged that his own way of demanding sacrifices was mistaken, but he stuck to his path in order to repay the lives he had taken. In the end he was defeated by the people of Earth, but the four $$スフィア$$s were taken by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and he perished in disappointment.
fixes.reason: pronoun/omitted possessive: 'The true identity is' -> 'His true identity is' (the entry settles whose; Vildark is male). Rest of the field is unchanged.

A patient who had been hospitalized in the special ward of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
They were caught up in a dimensional tremor along with their family, and were the sole survivor. Since then they have developed the phenomenon known as '$$血塗られた眼$$,' and appear to have lost all their emotions. The only feeling that remains is fear, and they sometimes cry out in sudden fits of terror at something unseen.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, these episodes grew more frequent, but since the $$時空修復$$ they have grown calmer, and their recovery is hoped for.
fixes.reason: pronoun: researched gender of this patient is unknown, so he/his/him must not be used; rewritten with singular they/their (as kw_000 does for the same patient description); meaning unchanged

fixes.new:
Number 4 of the $$アークセイバー$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. 23 years old.
Having Number 3, $$シュバル・レプテール$$, as a master, $$ウェイン$$ pilots the $$サフィーアダ$$, a unit of the same type as the $$エメラルダン$$ of $$シュバル$$.
He has a cynical disposition and is a self-confident man backed by real ability. His wild fighting style comes from natural talent and is highly regarded in some quarters.
Before studying under $$シュバル$$, he lived free and easy, and was therefore considered lacking in a knight's dignity, so the knight selection committee was in an uproar over his appointment as a $$ハイナイト$$, but in the end, on the recommendation of the $$ナイトオブナイツ$$, he took the post of Number 4 at a young age.
He is an unconventional knight in everything, but that free spirit is popular among the young people, and he has many female fans.
Incidentally, he was best friends with $$シェーヌ$$, the biological younger brother of $$マルグリット・ピステール$$.
In the world where the $$破界の王$$ appeared, after many twists and turns, he inherited the title and $$ディアムド$$ from $$ジェラウド$$ and fought in a manner worthy of them, but became the last $$ナイトオブナイツ$$ of $$インサラウム$$.
fixes.reason: omitted subject + pronoun: 'A cynical disposition...', 'The wild fighting style...' had no subject and the rest repeated the Wayne token; gender male is settled, so he/his replaces the repetition (name token kept in sentence 2 where Cheval is also present); 'the appointment' -> 'his appointment'

fixes.new:
One of the Dimensional Generals, beings who exist to fight the fundamental calamity.
After being defeated in battle with the fundamental calamity, $$ヴァイシュラバ$$ concluded that defeating them would require gathering warriors superior to $$次元獣$$s, and travels through the parallel worlds to organize a new army.
In one parallel world, after appearing in the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$ through a $$時空震動|lc$$, he lost all memory, turned warriors into $$次元獣$$s, and became the being known as the $$破界の王$$.
fixes.reason: pronoun: gender male is settled; the repeated name token in sentence 3 is replaced by 'he' (token kept in sentence 2)

kept_omissions: pilot 531 DSCR first line 'The holder of the Sphere ... who pilots ...': kept as a headline fragment, as the Japanese has no subject and the next sentence names 'he' (Aim, male); the entry settles it but the headline form matches the other entries' first lines.

pilot 536 DSCR/DSC2 '...a subordinate organization of Sidereal, which has managed the people of Earth since the distant past': the relative clause 遥か過去から地球人を管理してきた can attach to サイデリアル or to クロノ; the English keeps the ambiguity because neither this entry nor the brief settles it.

pilot 538 DSC2 last sentence 'the force that seeks to vanish, which had remained together with Advent': アドヴェントと共に残った could instead mean that Jie and Advent remained together; the entry does not settle whether it is the force or the man that stayed with Advent, the translator's reading kept.
pilot 530 DSCR 'He has studied the martial arts...' stays present tense as in the Japanese; not an omission.

pilot 536 DSCR/DSC2: 'Carlos Axion Jr.' (カルロス・アクシオン・Ｊｒ．) is written $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr., but that token is the father (this entry's own subject and pilot 525's true identity); the son Jr. is a different person, so the token points to the wrong person.
pilot 536 DSCR/DSC2: 'the codename King' is literal English; a token $$キング$$ (King, male) exists in the glossary and pilots 525/526 use it.

pilot 537 DSCR: renders as 'one of the "The Edel Bernal"' (token English includes 'The'); also $$クロノエイチ$$ (Black Wisdom) is a separate token from $$黒の英知$$ (Black Wisdom) used in pilot 538; the glossary should merge them.

pilot 538 DSCR/DSC2: '$$ジ・エーデル#pilot|lc$$s' gives 'the Edels'; and 538 DSC2 'hyperspacetime restoration' is literal English while pilot 529 uses the token $$超時空修復$$ (Hyper Spacetime Repair) for the same term.
pilot 527/528 DSC2: 'spirit particles' is literal for 霊子, while the token $$霊子吸収システム$$ = Spirit Quanta Absorption System; glossary English and the literal should agree.

pilot 538: 擬似真化 rendered 'pseudo true evolution' and 因果地平 'causal horizon' by the translator, unconfirmed by the wiki; left alone.

pilot 530 DSCR: 専横を許してしまった rendered 'allowed Anbrorn ... to seize control'; the Japanese says only 'allowed her high-handed rule'. Left as an acceptable reading.
pilot 523: in 'He is Advent's right hand, striving to live up to his expectations' 'his' could be read as Blue's own; the Japanese 彼 is Advent. If it reads ambiguous, use 'those expectations'.
pilots 521/522/534/535: in the Emperor/Vildark, Wayne and Vaishrava entries I replaced repeated name tokens with he/his under the new gender rule; each entry keeps at least one token of its subject.
